title: A Passage for the Provision
author: Edmund Ashgrove
blurb: Dominic Fairweather, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
